Nestled at the base of the Snoqualmie Mountain, Motel 6 Seattle East offers air-conditioned rooms with cable TV. Facilities include an outdoor pool. Lake Sammamish State Park is just 1.1 miles away.

The rooms at Motel 6 Seattle East – Issaquah are simply furnished. All rooms have an en suite bathroom.

Motel 6 Seattle East offers free local calls and free morning coffee. For your convenience, the motel also has laundry facilities and vending machines.

The Meydenbaur Center is 8.9 miles from Motel 6 Seattle East – Issaquah, and the Sea-Tac Airport is 16.9 miles away. Free parking is available on site.
